metadata.name: MiniMax-M2.1
metadata.variant_policy: Version-specific checkpoint. Serving speed tiers do not establish distinct architecture or weight identities; this record covers the named official HF checkpoint.

backbone.context_window_notes: Native 192K=196608 in M2 series report and this config.

attention.notes: Pinned config: rotary_dim=64 of head_dim=128; RoPE applies to half of each attention head.

moe.routing: Sigmoid routing with expert-specific bias; 8 of 256 routed experts active. Paper §2.2.1 says biases are optimized jointly with model parameters and reduce reliance on auxiliary losses; not assumed to be DeepSeek fixed-step auxiliary-loss-free updates.

auxiliary_modules.name: MTP speculative draft modules
auxiliary_modules.architecture: Three MTP modules; one transformer layer per module (config); original M2 report describes copy-initialization, short draft-only warmup, then joint training.
auxiliary_modules.notes: Config use_mtp=true, num_mtp_modules=3. Config alone does not verify tensor presence; no full weight download performed.

training.data_total_tokens: 29.2T for original M2 base (19.9T constant + 9.3T decay phase); version-specific additional training tokens undisclosed.
training.data_mix_notes: Shared M2 base pre-training: web, academic literature, books, code, structured QA; code/math/STEM upsampled. Series report describes agent-driven executable-workspace coding/cowork pipelines; per-checkpoint proportions undisclosed.

multi_token_prediction.loss_weight_schedule: Original M2: one MTP module during initial pre-training, weight 0.3→0.1 in decay; expanded to three MTP modules during continued pre-training (series report §2.3).
multi_token_prediction.shared_modules: Config for this checkpoint: num_mtp_modules=3, mtp_transformer_layers=1; paper Figure 2 follows DeepSeek-V3 style. Exact per-version loss schedule beyond original M2 undisclosed.

alignment.sft: Series report §5: rejection-sampled interleaved reasoning/action/observation trajectories in chat, reasoning, code and cowork; exact version-specific SFT mixture undisclosed.
alignment.rl_method: CISPO (series-wide report §6): clipped importance-sampling weights with agent/process rewards. Forge decouples training/inference from white-box or black-box agent scaffolds.

stages.name: Interleaved-thinking SFT
stages.description: Domain-reward rejection sampling and multi-stage data cleaning.

stages.name: Agent RL
stages.description: CISPO; Forge asynchronous infrastructure, windowed-FIFO scheduling and prefix-tree merging. This is a series-wide recipe, not a disclosed identical run per version.

inference_modes.name: Interleaved reasoning
inference_modes.trigger: Standard checkpoint use; preserve reasoning in assistant history.
inference_modes.description: M2 card explicitly requires retaining <think>...</think> across tool turns; no documented per-version effort axis.

tool_call_protocol.arguments_schema: One or more <invoke name="FUNCTION"><parameter name="ARG">VALUE</parameter></invoke>; strings emitted directly and non-string argument values JSON-encoded via tojson(ensure_ascii=False).
tool_call_protocol.notes: Tool messages serialized by pinned checkpoint template; parser flags not inferred from third-party recipes.

quantization.scope: All eligible modules except gate, e_score_correction_bias and lm_head (config.quantization_config.modules_to_not_convert).
quantization.notes: quant_method=fp8; config does not establish QAT versus PTQ. Training arithmetic remains UNKNOWN.

open_questions: The M2-series report retrospectively describes a common base and evolving data/RL system; exact additional tokens, optimizer, learning-rate schedule and per-version run configuration remain undisclosed.
MTP config metadata is not proof that every configured draft tensor is in the public checkpoint. Objective depth is supported by the paper; shipment remains UNKNOWN without tensor-index audit.
December 2025 release emphasizes multilingual development, native applications and concise responses; shared architecture values are read from this checkpoint config, not copied from M2.
Unknown fields are deliberate; no optimizer, token mixture, full training precision or version deltas are inherited from neighboring checkpoints without source attribution.
